title: Etale splitting of isolated fibre points into finite pieces with purely inseparable residue fields
statement:
Let $\mathcal U\in\mathcal V$ be the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $f:X\to S$ be a separated, locally of finite type morphism of $\mathcal U$-small schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $s\in S$, and let $x_1,\ldots,x_n$ be pairwise distinct isolated points of the fibre $X_s=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre, def-weil-residue-field]; isolated means that the singleton is open in this fibre. There exist a $\mathcal U$-small scheme $U$, an etale morphism $a:U\to S$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], a point $u\in U$ with $a(u)=s$, nonnegative integers $m_i$, and a decomposition
$$U\times_S X=W\amalg\coprod_{i=1}^n\coprod_{j=1}^{m_i}V_{i,j}$$
into pairwise disjoint open and closed subschemes [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-open-immersion]. The induced extension $\kappa(s)\to\kappa(u)$ is finite separable (finite-dimensional and separable algebraic). Each $V_{i,j}\to U$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], its fibre over $u$ consists of exactly one point $v_{i,j}$, that point maps to $x_i$ in $X_s$, and $\kappa(v_{i,j})/\kappa(u)$ is finite purely inseparable [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension]. No point of $W$ over $u$ maps to any $x_i$. Here the map to $X_s$ is induced on the fibre by $\kappa(s)\to\kappa(u)$. The empty list $n=0$ is allowed; $W$ is not required to be finite, and no flatness of $f$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 02LO, lemma-etale-splits-off-quasi-finite-part-technical-variant, statement and proof at lines 12136-12168. The finite separability of the pointed etale neighbourhood residue extension is the general fibre description in morphisms.tex, lemma-etale-over-field.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-local-finite-multiple-points] (Tag 02LM) to the prescribed points, regarding them as points of $X$ via the homeomorphism $X_s\to f^{-1}(s)$ in [def-pc-scheme-fibre]. Its hypotheses are precisely local finite type and pairwise distinct isolated fibre points; separatedness is not needed yet. Obtain an etale pointed neighbourhood $(U_0,u_0)\to(S,s)$ and finitely many finite open subschemes $V_\alpha\subset Y=U_0\times_S X$, indexed by $\alpha=(i,j)$, whose fibres at $u_0$ are singletons $v_\alpha$ with finite purely inseparable residue extensions. The distinguished points are all distinct, and every point of $Y_{u_0}$ mapping to any prescribed $x_i$ is one of these $v_{i,j}$. Write $q:Y\to U_0$ for the projection.

The residue extension $\kappa(s)\to\kappa(u_0)$ is finite separable: choose affine neighbourhoods $u_0\in B\subset U_0$ and $s\in A\subset S$ with $a(B)\subset A$. The affine-local characterization in [def-weil-etale-morphism] makes the restricted map etale. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-algebra-residue-field-separable] to its coordinate ring map and the primes representing $u_0,s$. These are the required scheme residue fields: restriction of the structure sheaf to an open does not change its stalks or their residue fields, by [def-weil-open-immersion] and [def-weil-residue-field].

source.place: Tag 02GL, lemma-etale-over-field (2), affine-local form via Algebra Tag 00U3, lemma-etale-over-field

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-separated-base-change], $q:Y\to U_0$ is separated. Each $V_\alpha\to U_0$ is proper by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-proper]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-proper-over-separated] with proper source $V_\alpha\to U_0$, separated target $Y\to U_0$, and the open inclusion $V_\alpha\hookrightarrow Y$: this inclusion is proper. Its image is closed, since proper means universally closed by [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Thus every $V_\alpha$ is both open and closed in $Y$.

source.place: Tag 02LO proof via Tag 02LN, lemma-etale-splits-off-quasi-finite-part-technical; Schemes Tag 01KU, Morphisms Tags 01WN and 01W6

proof.text: For distinct indices $\alpha,\beta$, the intersection $C_{\alpha\beta}=V_\alpha\cap V_\beta$ is closed in $V_\alpha$. Since $V_\alpha\to U_0$ is proper, its image $q(C_{\alpha\beta})$ is closed by [def-weil-proper-morphism]. This image avoids $u_0$: any point in the intersection above $u_0$ would have to equal both unique fibre points $v_\alpha$ and $v_\beta$, contrary to their distinctness. Delete the union of these finitely many closed images, obtaining an open neighbourhood $U\subset U_0$ of $u_0$. All intersections of the restricted pieces are empty. With no pairs the deleted union is empty.

source.place: Tag 02LO proof via Tag 02LN, removal of the closed images of pairwise intersections

proof.text: Let $u$ be $u_0$ regarded as a point of $U$, and restrict every $V_{i,j}$ to $U$. By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-morphism-permanence] (a) the restricted pieces are finite over $U$. They are clopen, being inverse images of clopen subsets. The open inclusion $U\hookrightarrow U_0$ is etale and its composite $a:U\to S$ is etale by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation]. The open inclusions identify the stalks and residue fields at $u$ and at all retained $v_{i,j}$ with the old ones ([def-weil-open-immersion], [def-weil-residue-field]); hence both the finite separability of $\kappa(u)/\kappa(s)$ and the finite purely inseparable extensions at $v_{i,j}$ persist. Restriction discards only points whose base image is outside $U$, so all distinguished fibre points remain and no other point over $u$ is introduced. The identification of the restricted total space with $U\times_S X$ is the iterated fibre-product identification, from [def-pc-fibre-product].

source.place: Tag 02LO proof via Tag 02LN, shrinking the base; Morphisms Tags 01WL and 02GN

proof.text: In $U\times_S X$ set $W$ equal to the complement of the finite union of the restricted $V_{i,j}$, with the induced open subscheme structure of [def-weil-open-immersion]. The union is open and closed (a finite union of clopen subsets), so $W$ is open and closed as well. The pieces are pairwise disjoint after step 4 and together with $W$ cover the total space. On a disjoint open cover, the structure sheaf restricts to the sheaves of the pieces, and its gluing axiom gives exactly the disjoint-union scheme decomposition in the statement. This argument also covers an empty index set: $W$ is then the whole total space.

source.place: Tag 02LO proof via Tag 02LN, final decomposition

proof.text: Finally suppose a point of $W$ above $u$ maps to $x_i$. In $Y$ it is a point above $u_0$ and $x_i$, so the exhaustion assertion of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-local-finite-multiple-points] identifies it with some $v_{i,j}$. That point lies in the retained $V_{i,j}$ and therefore cannot lie in its complement $W$. This contradiction proves the required avoidance clause. For $n=0$ it is vacuous; no finiteness of $W$ and no flatness of $f$ have been used.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q42-fc9c3fcb9 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read all seven steps of the split, every cited node's statement, and Stacks more-morphisms.tex lines 12040-12168 (Tags 02LM, 02LN, 02LO). There are no new nodes and no statement change. The statement matches 02LO hypothesis by hypothesis. Its one extra clause, that kappa(s)->kappa(u) is finite separable, is true for any etale map (Tag 02GL) and is proved in step 2. Step 1 takes only what the statement of 02LM gives: finite open pieces with singleton fibres, finite purely inseparable residue extensions, exhaustion, and distinct points. Its Lean is closed in slopmaster2. Steps 3-4 are the proof of 02LN with each fact cited to a node: separated base change, finite implies proper, proper over separated gives clopen pieces, and the closed images of the pairwise intersections miss u0 because the special points are distinct, so U can be shrunk. Step 5 cites finite base change (a) and etale composition (1)+(2), and checks that residue fields, singletons and exhaustion survive restriction. Steps 6-7 are elementary: the clopen complement W, and avoidance from the exhaustion clause. Edge cases tested: n=0, m_i=0, several lifts of one point, characteristic 0, nonreduced fibres; W is never assumed finite and flatness is never used. Whole-DAG grep for 02LO, 02LN, technical-variant and splits-off finds no duplicate; 02LP, 02LK, 04HM and 03X5 state different results. The two declared tool_uses are accepted: 02LM is a generic Lean-closed tool named by the blueprint's Tag 04QG route, and the residue-field lemma is a Mathlib leaf. No SGA citations. blueprint.from.node is null, inherited from the parent chain and not caused by this delivery. Remarks needing no change: U being U-small is covered by def-weil-size-convention and the U-universe Lean statement of 02LM; step 2's affine-chart reading of the etale definition suffices.
